Class PlanStore

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server.PlanStore
public final class PlanStore extends Object
In-memory, TTL-bounded store for DeploymentPlans produced by design_plan_deployment, keyed by the plan_id that tool returns so a later design_export_terraform call can pick the plan back up.

Scope: single-process only. Plan ids are valid only for the lifetime of this server process and cannot be resolved by any other process or server instance — if the MCP host restarts the server, previously issued ids are gone and the plan must be re-created. Entries expire after ttl() (default 30 minutes) and the store keeps at most capacity() plans, evicting the oldest.

Thread-safe; all methods synchronize on the store.
